summary: Added a Zod compatibility regression guard after Vercel exposed a ZodError.errors typecheck failure.
changes: Created scripts/security/check-zod-error-usage.mjs to fail on deprecated .error.errors usage and point contributors to ZodError.issues.
Inserted security:zod-compat into security:ci before typecheck.
Protected security:zod-compat from removal/retargeting in scripts/security/check-supply-chain.mjs.
Updated docs/security/SUPPLY_CHAIN.md with the Zod compatibility policy and checklist item.
notes: The previous build failure was a real TypeScript error, not Vercel build-rate-limit.
This round prevents the same Zod v4 compatibility issue from reappearing silently.
